summary: Lock down the grid. An ultra-fine, flashback-free powder that sets foundation for 16 hours while blurring micro-texture.
description: The final architectural seal. This weightless powder utilizes perfectly spherical silica particles to absorb oil and diffuse light, ensuring your high-fidelity base remains static and shine-free under any lighting condition.
technical_overview: Offered at $32.0 for 10g, this KoColor SETTING_POWDER is expertly formulated with Silica, Mica, and Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer. It delivers a high-fidelity Translucent color profile (`#FFFFFF`) and leverages light-scattering optics.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Press into the skin using a velour puff, focusing on high-sebum areas.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: For extreme longevity, "bake" the under-eyes for 3 minutes before sweeping away the excess.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Talc-free milling process ensures particles are small enough to sit seamlessly without emphasizing fine lines.
